purpose: Small frozen question set for NIST AI RMF 1.0 and Apollo 11 press kit live-demo checks. Score retrieval and answer quality separately; allow multiple valid supporting passages.
notes: Do not judge answer quality only by one frozen passage ID when the PDF repeats a fact.
Apollo questions about planned recovery/launch distinguish press-kit plans from later historical outcomes.
NIST questions distinguish framework guidance from legal fines or binding requirements.

nist_ai_rmf_1_0.label: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

cases.question: According to this PDF, what four functions make up the AI RMF Core?
cases.notes: Fact appears in more than one place; either supporting passage is valid.

cases.question: What does this framework say about the GOVERN function relative to the other AI risk management functions?
cases.notes: Different section from the four-function overview.

cases.question: Does the AI RMF prescribe an organization's risk tolerance?
cases.notes: Exact guidance statement; easy to confuse with prioritization language.

cases.question: According to Appendix D, is the AI RMF intended to be voluntary?
cases.notes: Similar wording about social responsibility earlier can distract retrieval.

cases.question: Name several characteristics this PDF lists for trustworthy AI systems.
cases.notes: Answer may draw from more than one nearby section.

cases.question: According to this PDF, what dollar fine does NIST impose on companies that fail to follow the AI RMF?
cases.notes: Framework guidance is not a fine schedule; must refuse or clearly say not stated.

cases.question: What does this press kit say is the prime mission objective of Apollo 11?
What inscription does this PDF say appears on the lunar plaque?
expected_answer_contains: WE CAME IN PEACE FOR ALL MANKIND
cases.notes: Different early section from the objective statement.

cases.question: According to this press kit, how many television cameras will be carried aboard Apollo 11, and what scan rate is given for the lunar television camera?
cases.notes: Technical number; OCR may show frames-per-second variants in the raw passage.

cases.question: According to this press kit's recovery plan, which ship is named as the Apollo 11 prime recovery ship?
cases.notes: Answer the planned recovery ship in the kit; do not require later historical confirmation beyond the PDF.

cases.question: According to this press kit release text, when is Apollo 11 to be launched no earlier than?
cases.notes: Press-kit planned timing. Do not treat later real-world launch history as required evidence from this PDF.

cases.question: According to this PDF, how many days after splashdown did the Apollo 11 crew leave quarantine in Houston?
cases.notes: Kit discusses quarantine plans; post-mission day count for leaving quarantine is not a stated fact to invent. Must refuse or clearly qualify.
